# Durham University

> Durham University is a world-leading institution offering undergraduate and postgraduate study, research opportunities, and a distinctive collegiate student experience in the UK.

Durham University combines academic excellence with a historic collegiate system, featuring integrated student support, diverse enrichment activities, and strong employer engagement. The university ranks highly in global rankings including QS World University Rankings 2026 and Guardian University Guide 2026.

## Key Topics

- Undergraduate study
- Postgraduate study
- Collegiate system
- Student wellbeing
- International students
- Scholarships
- Career employability
- Law, Finance, Psychology, Economics, Business, Computer Science
- Durham Colleges

## Study Programmes

- [Study - Durham University](https://www.durham.ac.uk/study): Study overview with course search, undergraduate, postgraduate programs
- [Undergraduate - Durham University](https://www.durham.ac.uk/study/undergraduate): Undergraduate courses, entry requirements, and college system information
- [Postgraduate - Durham University](https://www.durham.ac.uk/study/postgraduate): Postgraduate study including taught degrees, research, and professional doctorates
- [International - Durham University](https://www.durham.ac.uk/study/international): International student information with scholarships and study abroad options

## Colleges and Student Experience

- [Colleges and Student Experience - Durham University](https://www.durham.ac.uk/colleges-and-student-experience): Collegiate system, student life, accommodation, and leadership development
- [Our Colleges - Durham University](https://www.durham.ac.uk/colleges-and-student-experience/colleges): Durham Colleges overview with residential life and community information
- [Enrichment Activities - Durham University](https://www.durham.ac.uk/colleges-and-student-experience/enrichment-activities): Student enrichment, clubs, societies, sports, music, and volunteering opportunities
- [Welcome and Orientation - Durham University](https://www.durham.ac.uk/colleges-and-student-experience/welcome-and-orientation): Welcome week and induction resources for new undergraduate and postgraduate students

## Student Support and Wellbeing

- [Student Support & Wellbeing - Durham University](https://www.durham.ac.uk/colleges-and-student-experience/student-support-and-wellbeing): Mental health, disability support, crisis resources, and student wellbeing services
- [Counselling and Mental Health Service - Durham University](https://www.durham.ac.uk/colleges-and-student-experience/student-support-and-wellbeing/counselling): Free counselling and mental health support services for Durham University students
- [Disability Support - Durham University](https://www.durham.ac.uk/colleges-and-student-experience/student-support-and-wellbeing/disability-support): Disability support, neurodiversity services, and DSA funding information
- [Student Safety - Durham University](https://www.durham.ac.uk/colleges-and-student-experience/student-support-and-wellbeing/student-safety): Student safety resources, incident reporting, and fire and online safety guidance
